claim_boundary: C013 adds six descendants born from decisive or narrowing attacks. H098 contains a concrete exact witness but remains below PROVED pending independent review.

hypotheses.title: Complete-3CNF Exact Theta-Collision Lemma Candidate
hypotheses.statement: Let U be the conjunction of all eight width-three clauses on x1,x2,x3, and let S be the eight clauses obtained by adjoining the common positive literal x4 to the same sign patterns. Their clause-literal conflict graphs have common clause target 8, exact independence numbers 7 and 8 respectively, and exact Lovasz theta value 8, witnessed by rational primal-dual certificates verified by the H092-H093 machinery.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: This constructively discharges the finite-seed existence requested by H096 and gives a fixed exact counterexample to completeness of the standard first Lovasz-theta SAT relaxation.
hypotheses.proof_role: ADVERSARIAL_TARGET: replace H096's existential search by one explicit opposite-label pair with exact rational certificates.
hypotheses.next_gate: Obtain independent review of the orbit-derived primal matrix and reproduce the bundle outside the repository implementation.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H098 supplies the concrete formulas, rational primal matrices, rational dual slacks, exact alpha values, and executable bundle that H096 only conjectured to exist.
falsification_conditions: Failure of either formula label, exact alpha computation, primal feasibility, dual feasibility, or objective equality under independent replay.
A mismatch between the displayed formulas and the graphs certified by the executable artifact.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The lemma concerns the standard clause-literal conflict graph and first theta level only. Novelty is not claimed and P versus NP is not resolved.

hypotheses.title: Explicit Infinite Standard-Theta Twin Family Lemma Candidate
hypotheses.statement: For every r at least one, take r variable-disjoint renamed copies of each H098 formula. The SAT side remains satisfiable, the UNSAT side remains unsatisfiable, both clause targets equal 8r, and both conflict graphs have exact Lovasz theta value 8r by disjoint-union additivity.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: A single finite H098 seed becomes an explicit polynomial-time constructible infinite SAT/UNSAT family invisible to the standard first theta level.
hypotheses.proof_role: ADVERSARIAL_BRIDGE: combine H098 with the H095 amplification step to obtain an asymptotic obstruction rather than an isolated finite example.
hypotheses.next_gate: Commit a complete primal-dual proof of theta additivity in the H093 normalization and independently replay several amplified bundles.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H099 instantiates H095 with the exact H098 seed and fixes the generator, clause count, labels, and theta value for every family member.
falsification_conditions: Failure of theta additivity under graph disjoint union in the exact H093 convention.
Unexpected cross-copy conflict edges after the required variable renaming.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The family only defeats the standard first theta relaxation; it does not rule out higher theta levels or other preprocessing.

hypotheses.title: Potential-Decreasing Local Treewidth Compiler Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There exist a finite bounded-radius CNF rewrite grammar, a polynomial-bit locally computable potential Phi, and constants c,k such that every rewrite strictly decreases Phi, no rule can inspect or encode a global acceptance bit, and canonical rewriting maps every length-N CNF to a polynomial-size equisatisfiable CNF of primal treewidth at most c log N with polynomial witness recovery.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: The restricted compiler followed by bounded-treewidth dynamic programming would decide SAT in polynomial time without the unrestricted solve-and-encode defect of H001 or the unconstrained long computation defect of H009.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_ALGORITHM: salvage the local-treewidth route after rejecting unrestricted lifts and exposing universal computation in iterated local rules.
hypotheses.next_gate: Define one admissible potential language and prove a lower bound or construct a concrete rule set on expander Tseitin and random-CNF families.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H100 adds a strictly decreasing local potential and explicitly forbids a global acceptance-bit channel, closing the two circularity attacks that defeated H001 and weakened H009.
falsification_conditions: An explicit CNF family on which every admissible potential-decreasing grammar leaves omega(log N) treewidth or has superpolynomial output.
A proof that the restrictions still simulate an arbitrary polynomial-time SAT solver.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: No grammar or lower bound is supplied. The potential restriction must be formalized before the conjecture is a complete mechanism.

hypotheses.title: Restriction-Robust Mixed Residual Generator Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There exists one deterministic polynomial-time generator of mixed XOR and non-affine CNFs such that after exhaustive certified Gaussian elimination and every restriction leaving n^delta live variables, either the residual has theta rank n^Omega(1) and superlogarithmic separator width or every equivalent representation in the H017 compiler language has superpolynomial size.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: The same explicit family would attack H017, H072, H083, H090, and parity-aware proof routes with one restriction-stable residual invariant.
hypotheses.proof_role: ADVERSARIAL_TARGET: turn the missing explicit family exposed by attacks on H017 into a single common lower-bound target.
hypotheses.next_gate: Fix the expander XOR core and one nonlinear gadget, then prove pseudoexpectation transport under restrictions and Gaussian elimination.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H101 merges the separate width, theta-rank, and restriction-closure obligations into one generator whose residual is measured simultaneously after all permitted affine simplifications.
falsification_conditions: A permitted affine and local compilation reducing the generated family to logarithmic width and bounded theta rank with polynomial size.
A large restriction that destroys every proposed residual hardness witness.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The generator is not yet constructed; this is the point at which the parity route currently reaches an open lower-bound barrier.

hypotheses.title: Typed Bounded-Support Interface Elimination Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There exist a fixed finite typed interface language and a canonical variable-elimination scheduler such that every interface node is an explicit Boolean circuit over named original variables, its full original-variable support is stored and charged, AND nodes have disjoint support, OR nodes have certified deterministic alternatives, and every CNF compiles in polynomial size while exposing at most O(log N) support per interface and preserving witnesses.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: This would repair H019's undefined interface symbols while yielding a direct SAT algorithm; the explicit decomposability and determinism conditions also make known DNNF lower bounds immediately applicable as attacks.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_ALGORITHM: salvage proof-carrying elimination after rejecting H019's untyped interface language.
hypotheses.next_gate: Apply the H016 projection argument to determine whether the stated typed language is already destroyed by unconditional DNNF lower bounds.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H102 replaces opaque boundary symbols by explicit charged original-variable supports and fixes the composition semantics that H019 omitted.
falsification_conditions: A proof that the typed compilation is a polynomial-size DNNF for every CNF, contradicting explicit DNNF lower bounds.
A concrete formula forcing superpolynomial nodes or support above logarithmic size.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The explicit DNNF-like restrictions may make H102 easier to refute than H019; that is intentional.

hypotheses.title: One-Pass Local Theta-Gap Compiler Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There exist a fixed one-pass bounded-radius signed-incidence transduction and constants c,k that map every CNF F of length N to a graph G_F and target M_F using only polynomially many constant-size clause and variable gadgets, without adaptive iteration or a global semantic oracle, such that SAT iff alpha(G_F)=M_F and UNSAT implies theta(G_F)<=M_F-1/N^c with polynomial-bit dual certificates.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: This would restore a noncircular theta-gap route to P = NP after rejection of the unrestricted compiler in H070.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_ALGORITHM: prohibit solve-and-encode and adaptive global computation while retaining the certified theta-gap goal.
hypotheses.next_gate: Run the explicit H098 collision and local gadget substitutions against every candidate transduction and seek a pseudoexpectation-preserving impossibility theorem.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H103 replaces H070's arbitrary polynomial compiler by a fixed nonadaptive local graph transduction and inherits H098 as its first mandatory counterexample test.
falsification_conditions: An explicit opposite-label family whose bounded-degree pseudoexpectations survive every allowed local transduction, forcing equal theta values.
A proof that no one-pass local gadget map can create the required inverse-polynomial gap on H098 amplifications.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The conjecture does not allow arbitrary polynomial preprocessing. It remains open only at the local-transduction lower-bound frontier.
